sourceRefs.locator: B, Prosper, entry for 435: peace and an unspecified part of Africa for settlement.
Timeline, p. xiii, entry 435: first agreement with the western empire and a reconstruction involving the Mauretanias and part of Numidia.

labels.en: Western provinces of Roman North Africa

summary.de: Mauretanien und Numidien lagen westlich von Karthago. Die knappen Texte zur Vereinbarung von 435 lassen den Verlauf der betroffenen Gebietsgrenzen offen.
summary.en: Mauretania and Numidia lay west of Carthage. Brief accounts of the 435 agreement leave the boundaries of the area concerned uncertain.
